title: JRE 2349 - Danny Jones
guestBio: Danny Jones is the host of “The Danny Jones Podcast,” a program exploring the fringes of culture and the boundaries of free thought.
tldr: Danny Jones discusses how The Danny Jones Podcast developed around exploring ideas that mainstream media and cultural institutions are reluctant to examine
Conversation covers the specific topics that have built Danny's audience, including alternative history, free thought philosophy, and the boundaries of acceptable discourse
Joe and Danny on the current state of independent long-form podcasting and whether the golden era of unfiltered conversation is under genuine threat
Discussion of how Danny approaches guests and topics that carry reputational risk in the current media environment and what he has learned from taking those risks
Danny shares which subjects he is personally most obsessed with and which episodes changed how he thinks about his own assumptions and worldview
Conversation about what drives growing audiences toward fringe culture content and what that appetite reveals about mainstream media's failures and blind spots
